title: Second Marriage
content: I've been divorced. For a while I figured that chapter was closed. Then I met my wife later in life, both of us with histories, and she calls me on my stuff in a way nobody else does. It's not simple. It's the best thing I've been part of. Love doesn't have to be first to be real.
